statement: Correction to C007's scope: retrieval-layer metrics are not absent from the literature in general, since TempRALM reports recall@1 and recall@5 of the gold passage. What is absent is version-selection accuracy (the fraction of top-k passages belonging to the version in force at the query date) for legal amendment retrieval, and Prior et al. themselves report no retrieval ranking metrics, only end-answer scores with k=6 embedding retrieval. Confidence in C007 is retained for its scoped legal-amendment claim, but the unqualified reading that no work reports retrieval metrics is withdrawn.

evidence.quote: In addition, we evaluate the retrievers of both models using a recall@1 and recall@5 metrics
utilizing cosine similarity over the embeddings
